locations.title: PC
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Obtain the [S.T.A.R.S Badge](#loc=544572)
- Press a switch on the back to turn it into a USB Dongle Key
- Insert it into the PC, then interact with the nearby computer

locations.title: Emperor Statue
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Pick up the [Statue's Left Arm](#loc=544516)
- Combine it with the [Red Book (Art Object)](#loc=544504)
- Attach the Left Arm with Book to the statue

locations.title: Electronically-locked Door
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- [Power Panel Part](#loc=544539) + [Power Panel Part](#loc=544672)
- Rotate the pieces so they resemble the screenshot above

locations.title: Clock Tower Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Put the [Large Gear](#loc=544530) in the [Gear Box](#loc=544542) to lower the stairs
- Take the [Small Gear](#loc=544559) from the gear box upstairs, and put it in the [Gear Box](#loc=544541)
- Put the Large Gear in the [Gear Box](#loc=544558) upstairs, and the [Power Panel Part](#loc=544539) will be yours!

locations.title: Picture Block Puzzle
locations.description:
This puzzle is partially random, but can be consistently solved in the same way.

**Solution:**
- Insert the [Picture Block](#loc=545838)
- Move the second block to the left by one spot
- Move the third block to the left by one spot
- Rotate the blocks until they form a complete sequence, as seen in the screenshot

locations.title: Chess Plug Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:**

- [King Plug](#loc=545999) in [Plug Socket 1](#loc=545923)
- [Queen Plug](#loc=545993) in [Plug Socket 2](#loc=545924)
- [Pawn Plug](#loc=545933) in [Plug Socket 3](#loc=545925)
- [Knight Plug](#loc=545930) in [Plug Socket 4](#loc=545926)
- [Rook Plug](#loc=545951) in [Plug Socket 5](#loc=545927)
- [Bishop Plug](#loc=545931) in [Plug Socket 6](#loc=545928)

locations.title: King & Queen Puzzle
locations.description:
**Solution:**
- Grab the [Queen Plug](#loc=545993) and slot it into [Plug Socket 9](#loc=545995)
- Go upstairs, grab the [King Plug](#loc=545999), then drop down.
  - A zombie will be lurking - watch out!
- Use the King Plug to unlock [Plug Socket 10](#loc=545997) and unlock the [One-Way Door](#loc=545990).
  - Grab the Spark Shot if you have the space!
- Reclaim both plugs; use them to power up [Plug Socket 8](#loc=545992) and [Plug Socket 7](#loc=545989).
- Go through Socket 7's door to reach the Queen plug. Take it, go back through the previous door, then take the King plug. Done!
